title: I. Question. Whether Recreation be lawfull for a Christian man?

segments.text: Ans. Yea, and that for two causes.

First, Rest from labour, with the refreshing of bodie and mind, is necessarie; because mans nature is like the bow, which being alway bent and vsed, is soone broken in pieces. Now that which is necessarie, is lawfull. And if rest be lawfull, then is recreation also lawfull.

Secondly, by Christian libertie, we are allowed to vse the creatures of God, not onely for our necessitie, but also for meete and convenient delight. This is a confessed truth; and therefore to them, which shall condemne fit and conuenient recreation (as some of the ancient Fathers haue done, by name Chrysostome and Ambrose) it may be said, be not to righteous, be not to wise. Eccl. 7. 18.
